transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what’s been troubling you or what brings you in today?

Well... I guess I just can't keep my mind on one thing anymore. It's becoming a problem at work. I'm at a warehouse, and... if a beeper goes off, or a forklift alarm, or even just someone moving a pallet... it pulls me right off my count. Then I realize I've put the wrong numbers in the inventory. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Do you often feel restless or find yourself moving around a lot when you're supposed to be staying still?

I suppose... yeah. Mostly after my shifts. Usually I'm pretty worn out from the warehouse, but lately... I don't know, I come home kind of buzzing. 

Sitting down on the couch just feels impossible right now. So I end up... reorganizing cabinets. Or sorting through bins out in the garage. Just... keeping moving, I guess.
Do you find it hard to focus or stay on task in other parts of your life, like at home or when you’re talking with friends?

I don't know... I haven't really noticed. I don't see a lot of people outside of work anyway. And at home, I'm mostly just... moving around, doing things in the garage, like I said. So... I guess not.
When you're at home doing routine tasks or trying to relax, do you find yourself losing focus or getting distracted easily?
I... I'm not really sure. Like I said, I'm mostly just keeping busy. I don't really try to sit down and relax much lately, so... I don't know if I get distracted or not. I'm just doing stuff.
When you're doing something at home, like watching TV or eating a meal, do you find it hard to focus or get distracted easily?
I don't really watch much TV anymore. And meals... I usually just eat standing up in the kitchen. So... I haven't really noticed being distracted. There's not much to focus on.
When you're in a quiet place, like sitting in your car waiting or standing in line at the store, do you find your thoughts drifting or your mind getting pulled in different directions?
I guess I just... wait. I don't really pay attention to what my mind is doing when I'm in line. I just look at the shelves or whatever until it's my turn. So... no, not really.
When you're in a situation where you need to sit still and focus, like filling out paperwork or listening during a meeting at work, do you find it hard to stay focused or your mind starts to wander?

Well, I guess... that's actually kind of why I'm here. I work at a warehouse, and... I just can't keep my mind on one thing lately. Like, if I'm trying to do a count, and a forklift alarm goes off, or someone drops a pallet, or a scanner beeps... I just lose my place. My mind just goes to whatever the noise is. And then... I'll look down and realize I've put all the wrong numbers into the inventory system. It's... it's becoming a problem.
Have you ever found yourself forgetting things often or being forgetful in your daily routines, like forgetting where you put something or missing appointments?
I don't... I don't think so. I mean, everyone forgets where they put their keys sometimes, but... no, not really. I usually remember my appointments and stuff.
Looking back, were you noticeably restless, fidgety, or had trouble staying focused when you were a child, like in school or during family activities?
No... I don't think so. That was a long time ago, but... I was fine in school. I wasn't bouncing off the walls or anything. Just normal, I guess.
Do you often feel worried or anxious, like something bad is going to happen, especially when you're trying to focus on your work or when things are busy around you?
No, not really. I just... I get distracted by the noise. It's not that I'm worried about anything. Just can't focus.
Do you often lose things that you need for your work or daily tasks, like tools, paperwork, or your personal belongings?
No... not really. I need my tools for work, so I make sure I know where they are. I don't really lose things.
Do you often feel like you need to finish one thing right away before moving on to the next, like you can't wait to get something done and it makes you act quickly without thinking?
No, I don't think so. I just... do things at a normal pace. I'm not really one to rush into things without thinking.
Do you often have trouble organizing your tasks or keeping things in order, either at work or at home?
No, not really. I manage fine. Things are... they're where they need to be.
Outside of work, like when you're at home doing something simple or talking to someone, do you ever find yourself struggling to pay attention or feeling like your mind is easily pulled away?

Well... I guess that's sort of why I'm here. I just... I can't seem to keep my mind on one thing lately. It's mostly at work, though. At the warehouse, if a beeper goes off, or the forklift alarm sounds, or... or even just someone moving a pallet nearby... it just pulls me right off whatever I'm doing. Like, I'll be doing a count, get distracted, and then I realize I've put the wrong numbers into the inventory. It's just... hard to stay focused right now.
Do you find yourself getting easily distracted or feeling restless in situations outside of work, like when you're running errands, reading something, or trying to wind down at night?
I don't think so. I mean, not really. Just the usual stuff, I guess. I don't really notice it much outside of the warehouse.
Have you noticed any difficulty focusing or being easily distracted in situations other than work, such as when you're reading, trying to fall asleep, or engaging in a quiet conversation?
Like I just said... no, not really. I don't read much anyway, but... no. It's really just at the warehouse. I don't know what else to tell you.
Do you often find yourself acting without thinking, like interrupting others, blurting out answers, or starting new tasks before finishing old ones?
No, I don't think so. I... I just try to keep to myself mostly. I don't really interrupt people.
If you're in a quiet, distraction-free environment, like sitting alone in a room, do you find your mind wandering or do you have difficulty maintaining focus on what you're doing?
No... not really. If I'm just sitting by myself, I'm fine. I just sit there, or maybe watch TV. I don't have a problem focusing on that.

inference_history.note: The patient reports difficulty maintaining focus, being easily distracted by external stimuli, and issues with task performance at work.
